details: The crypto market is in a post-correction consolidation phase. Bitcoin found support near $62,800, but upside momentum is limited, with $64,000 as a key resistance. Ethereum's Layer 2 (L2) Total Value Locked (TVL) is at its lowest since 2023, indicating weakening interest in traditional scaling solutions. Broader markets are also impacted by geopolitical concerns and a tech sector correction.
title: Crypto Market Under Pressure, BTC Consolidates Below $64K

details: Bitcoin is facing an immediate market test at $64,000, as three key demand channels lose momentum. US spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced a combined $526.5 million in net outflows over four consecutive sessions. Weaker perpetual futures buying and stagnant on-chain capital inflows, reported by Glassnode, leave long-term holders as the primary support.
title: Bitcoin's $64K Support Tested as Demand Drivers Stall

details: Ethereum has reached a significant milestone, surpassing 200 million non-empty wallets, indicating a continuous growth in user activity. Analyst Dan Tapiero suggests this trend could lead to Ethereum outperforming Bitcoin. Additionally, the "Glamsterdam" upgrade, designed to enhance network speed and reduce fees, is in its final testing stages and is anticipated to launch in Q3 or Q4 2026.
title: Ethereum User Adoption Soars Past 200 Million Wallets, Glamsterdam Upgrade Nears

details: Bitcoin dropped below $64,000 following the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting. While no rate hike was announced, SEC Chair Paul Atkins hinted at future increases, contributing to a sell-off in the crypto market. Separately, the US Treasury Department has sanctioned Iranian entities for using Bitcoin to bypass international restrictions. Meanwhile, Tether is expanding its operations into Africa.
title: BTC Dips Below $64K After FOMC; US Sanctions Iran Over Crypto Use

details: Crypto credit markets demonstrated resilience in June and July, largely unaffected by broader macro pressures and Bitcoin's 20.1% decline in June. Unlike previous drawdowns, this one was macro-driven rather than triggered by contagion events within crypto. Institutional capital has further penetrated on-chain credit, and tokenized real-world assets reached new highs of $30.1 billion.
title: Crypto Credit Resilient Amid Macro Volatility Despite Bitcoin Decline

details: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $32.1 million in net inflows on July 30, marking the end of a four-day outflow streak. This development suggests a renewed institutional interest in Bitcoin, with products like BlackRock's IBIT and Fidelity's FBTC seeing significant activity. In contrast, Ethereum ETFs continue to experience outflows.
title: Bitcoin ETFs End Outflow Streak with $32.1M Inflows

details: On July 29, US-listed spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $89.8 million in net inflows, reversing earlier weakness and indicating continued institutional demand. BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) was a notable contributor. Spot Ethereum ETFs also recorded positive inflows of $9.4 million, although at a slower pace compared to earlier in July.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Rebound with Inflows, Ethereum Inflows Slow

details: A research director at ARK Invest suggests the cryptocurrency market is undergoing its "biggest consolidation phase" in history, indicating a shift towards more selective capital deployment. This period is expected to result in increased mergers and acquisitions, bankruptcies, and shutdowns, but is ultimately viewed as a bullish development for the long-term health of the space as investors focus on projects with strong fundamentals.
title: ARK Analyst: Crypto Enters "Biggest Consolidation Phase"

details: The Federal Reserve maintained interest rates steady on July 29, but a hawkish stance from the central bank could limit Bitcoin's upward movement. According to analysis by CoinDesk, tighter monetary policy has the potential to drain liquidity and increase the cost associated with maintaining leveraged crypto positions, thereby exerting downward pressure on BTC prices.
title: Hawkish Fed Stance May Cap Bitcoin Gains

details: JPMorgan and several other major banks are actively developing tokenized deposits on blockchain infrastructure to compete with stablecoins. This initiative aims to retain crucial bank deposits, which are vital for lending operations, rather than losing them to stablecoin issuers. Bank opposition to certain yield provisions is currently impacting the progression of the CLARITY Act.
title: Banks Build Blockchain Rails to Counter Stablecoin Threat

details: Ostium has attributed a recent $24 million exploit to an off-chain breach, explicitly ruling out any smart contract flaw. This incident underscores broader security challenges and highlights the importance of comprehensive security measures beyond just smart contract audits for crypto firms.
title: Ostium Blames Off-Chain Breach for $24M Exploit

details: Reports indicate that Russian authorities have detained the founder of BitRiver, a prominent crypto mining firm, on fraud charges. This development signals increasing regulatory scrutiny and potential legal risks within the cryptocurrency mining sector in Russia and potentially beyond.
title: Russia Detains Crypto Mining Firm BitRiver Founder on Fraud

details: Binance.US announced its intention to apply for a CFTC (Commodity Futures Trading Commission) license in August for its prediction market platform. This strategic move signifies a push towards regulated offerings and expansion into new financial products within the highly scrutinized US market.
title: Binance.US to Apply for CFTC License for Prediction Markets

details: The Solana Policy Institute is actively advocating for the US Senate to pass comprehensive cryptocurrency legislation. They are emphasizing the urgent need for clear digital asset regulations to foster innovation, provide market certainty, and define the legal framework for the rapidly evolving crypto industry.
title: Solana Policy Institute Urges Senate to Act on Crypto Bill

details: Tether has introduced its GENIUS-compliant USAT stablecoin on the Celo blockchain, marking a significant expansion beyond its initial presence solely on the Ethereum network. This move aims to enhance stablecoin utility, increase liquidity, and promote greater interoperability across different blockchain ecosystems.
title: Tether's USAT Stablecoin Launches on Celo Blockchain
